Subject: Thing in the Cellar, a chunky cute wide heap of a monster shown whole, a mound wider than it is tall: many fat rubbery deep-sea teal tentacles with pale cream suckers piled up and curling outward, many friendly round pale yellow eyes of different sizes with black pupils all over it, one round weathered grey-brown wooden trapdoor lid in its middle, one tiny striped party hat on top; no legs, no arms, no teeth; clearly a silly friendly monster, not scary; simple shapes and very few details. The heap is drawn large and fills the whole square. Must not include: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject, pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple creatures, crowd, robe, hood, cloak, cloth, armour, weapon, flames, fire, candle, horns, claws, fangs, blood, gore, horror, realistic, octopus head, face, mouth, teeth, legs.

review.notes: The Thing in the Cellar whole: a heap of teal tentacles with many yellow eyes, the round wooden trapdoor lid in its middle and the striped party hat on top, as the map sprite; a taller heap than the sprite's. No red or violet. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-anchor.subject: ICON:ACTION:ANCHOR
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-anchor.notes: Anchor: a teal tentacle coiled three times round a candle with a green flame. Reads as a candle in a coil at 24 and 18 px. Pixen drew the coil steel blue with salmon suckers; the cult-summoned-icon accent makes it teal and the suckers peach. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-behold.subject: ICON:ACTION:BEHOLD
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-behold.notes: Behold!: the grinning grey stone idol head with green eyes and eight cream rays. Reads as a grey face with rays at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark token. Two small green wisps sit at its lower right. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-boo.subject: ICON:ACTION:BOO
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-boo.notes: Boo!: the Horror's face close up, a sibling of its portrait: a round teal head with two googly yellow eyes, a very wide grin of blunt cream teeth and cream startle spikes round it. Reads as a grinning face at 24 and 18 px on every ground. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-channel.subject: ICON:ACTION:CHANNEL
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-channel.notes: Channel: a cream mitten in an indigo cuff holding up a green chain. Reads as a green chain in a hand at 24 px and as a green strand at 18 px. Difference from the direction: a chain of four links, not one link. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-grab.subject: ICON:ACTION:GRAB
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-grab.notes: Grab: a brown boot with a teal tentacle tip curled over its ankle from behind. Reads as a boot caught by a tentacle at 24 px; close to Seize by design (Seize coils from below, Grab hooks from behind). Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-great-s.subject: ICON:ACTION:GREAT_SUMMONING
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-great-s.notes: The Great Summoning: one big pale yellow eye with a black pupil on an indigo diamond, with four small candles with green flames at its corners. Reads as the Herald's eye among green lights at 24 and 18 px. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-martyr.subject: ICON:ACTION:MARTYR
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-martyr.notes: Martyr: a round brass medal on two cream ribbon ends with a small green flame over it. Reads as a medal with ribbons at 24 and 18 px. Differences from the direction: two ribbon ends, not a folded sash; their purple shading and the yellow-green flame are indigo and the faction green after the cult-lodge-icon accent. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-offerin.subject: ICON:ACTION:OFFERING
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-offerin.notes: Offering: a round brass dish with two fat candles, one lit green and one unlit. Reads as a dish with a green flame at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark token. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-pamphle.subject: ICON:ACTION:PAMPHLETS
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-pamphle.notes: Pamphlets: a sheaf of cream pamphlets, the front one with the indigo eye-in-a-spiral sign. Reads as papers with the eye sign at 24 and 18 px; the clump under them is gone. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-pick-me.subject: ICON:ACTION:PICK_ME
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-pick-me.notes: Pick Me!: an open waving hand in a cream glove, palm to the viewer and all five fingers spread, on an indigo cuff before a spiky brass starburst. Reads as an open raised hand in a burst at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark marker token; no single extended finger. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-proclai.subject: ICON:ACTION:PROCLAIM
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-proclai.notes: Proclaim: a big unrolled cream scroll with the indigo eye-in-a-spiral sign and a brass hand bell at its corner. Reads as a scroll with a round sign and a bell at 24 and 18 px on every ground. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-ribbit.subject: ICON:ACTION:RIBBIT
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-ribbit.notes: Ribbit: a fat teal frog with a cream belly and yellow eyes and a green sparkle. Reads as a frog at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass (teal, not a green frog) and on the dark token. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-sacrifi.subject: ICON:ACTION:SACRIFICE
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-sacrifi.notes: Sacrifice: an empty pointed indigo hood with its black opening over a round puff of green smoke. Reads as a hood over green smoke at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark token. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-seize.subject: ICON:ACTION:SEIZE
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-seize.notes: Seize: one brown boot with a teal tentacle with cream suckers coiled round it from below. Reads as a boot in a tentacle's grip at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark token. Teal after the cult-summoned-icon accent. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-starfal.subject: ICON:ACTION:STARFALL
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-starfal.notes: Star-fall: a plain cream five-pointed star falling with a long green tail. Reads as a falling star at 24 and 18 px on every ground. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-summon.subject: ICON:ACTION:SUMMON
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-summon.notes: Summon: a low ring with a big green flame in it and one teal tentacle tip curling over its rim. Reads as a green flame in a ring at 24 and 18 px on every ground. Differences from the direction: the chalk circle is a low stone ring and one tentacle tip shows, not two. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-switche.subject: ICON:ACTION:SWITCHEROO
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-switche.notes: Switcheroo: two thick curved arrows forming a circle, the upper cream and the lower green. Reads at 24 and 18 px on every ground. Difference from the direction: no puff in the middle. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-tentacl.subject: ICON:ACTION:TENTACLE
chibi-direction-icon-cult-action-tentacl.notes: Tentacle: one teal tentacle with cream suckers rising from a dark base and curled over like a hook. Reads as a hooked tentacle at 24 and 18 px. The crack is a small dark mound. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-emblem.subject: ICON:HUD:CULT:EMBLEM
chibi-direction-icon-cult-emblem.notes: The faction emblem: a green eye in a green spiral on a patch of indigo cloth with brass corners. Reads as an eye in a spiral, green on indigo, at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark token. It fills the whole canvas. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-favour.subject: ICON:HUD:CULT:FAVOUR
chibi-direction-icon-cult-favour.notes: The Favour candle of the HUD at 32 x 32: one fat warm cream candle with drips and a tall green flame, nothing under it; 16 x 28 px. Reads as a candle with a green flame at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark token. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-favour-large.subject: ICON:HUD:CULT:FAVOUR_LARGE
chibi-direction-icon-cult-favour-large.notes: The Favour candle at 48 px: a fat wax candle with drips and a big green flame with a yellow core; the loose speck is gone. Reads as a candle with a green flame at 24 and 18 px. The wax is a warm tan, which carries on the cream plates better than the target cream would. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-candlel.subject: ICON:STATUS:CANDLELIT
chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-candlel.notes: Candlelit: a fat wax candle with a green flame under a thin cream halo ring. The flame and the halo read at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark token; the wax is a warm cream, a little tanner than the target. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6. Accepted again with the cult-lodge-icon accent.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-cowed.subject: ICON:STATUS:COWED
chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-cowed.notes: The Cowed chip: a round window in a cream frame filled by two closed indigo shutter halves with a brass latch. Reads as a shut round window at 24 and 16 px on the dark token and on the cream plates. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-frog.subject: ICON:STATUS:FROG
chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-frog.notes: The Frog chip: the teal frog seen from the front, its wide head and yellow eyes filling the image. Reads as a frog's face at 24 and 16 px on the dark token and on the cream plates. Its feet show under the head. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-furious.subject: ICON:STATUS:FURIOUS
chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-furious.notes: The Furious chip: two big red eyes under two puffs of white steam on a dark round head; the horns and the tongue of the creation are gone. Reads as two red eyes under steam at 24 and 16 px on the dark token (the dark head merges with it) and on the cream plates. The one Cult icon with red: the cue of an Unbound daemon. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-grabbed.subject: ICON:STATUS:GRABBED
chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-grabbed.notes: The Grabbed chip: one tentacle curled into a closed loop with a cream underside. Reads as a loop at 24 and 16 px on the dark token, on Grass and on the cream plates. Pixen drew it steel blue; the cult-summoned-icon accent makes it teal. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-pick-me.subject: ICON:STATUS:PICK_ME
chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-pick-me.notes: The Pick Me! chip: the open waving hand of the Pick Me! icon on its indigo cuff, all five fingers spread, without the starburst. Reads as an open raised hand at 24 and 16 px on the dark token, on Grass and on the cream plates; no single extended finger. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-unbound.subject: ICON:STATUS:UNBOUND
chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-unbound.notes: The Unbound chip: a spiked brass collar lying open with a length of chain trailing from it. Reads as a spiked ring with a loose chain at 24 px and as a spiked ring at 16 px on the dark token. Differences from the direction: the crack does not read, the loose chain carries it; a small green flame sits on the collar. Its red-brown brass shading is brass after the cult-lodge-icon accent. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-warded.subject: ICON:STATUS:WARDED
chibi-direction-icon-cult-status-warded.notes: The Warded chip: the grinning stone idol head with green eyes inside two chalk rings. Reads as a face in a ring at 24 and 16 px on the dark token and on the cream plates. The stone is a cool grey with an indigo tint. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-tech-harvest-r.subject: ICON:TECH:CULT:FARMING
chibi-direction-icon-cult-tech-harvest-r.notes: Harvest Rites: a wheat sheaf tied with an indigo ribbon beside a fat candle with a green flame. Reads as a sheaf and a candle at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates and on Grass. The wheat's purple shading and the azure ribbon are indigo after the cult-lodge-icon accent; the flame has a small orange core. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-icon-cult-tech-stars-are.subject: ICON:TECH:CULT:EXPLOSIVES
chibi-direction-icon-cult-tech-stars-are.notes: The Stars Are Right: a round brass star chart disc with an indigo face and three cream stars in a line. Reads as a brass-rimmed disc with three stars at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark marker token; indigo, cream and brass only. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6. Accepted again with the cult-lodge-icon accent (no pixel changed role).

chibi-direction-icon-cult-tech-warding-c.subject: ICON:TECH:CULT:FORTIFICATION
chibi-direction-icon-cult-tech-warding-c.notes: Warding Circles: a squat grinning pale grey stone idol with green eyes standing in a cream chalk ring. Reads as an idol in a ring at 24 and 18 px on the cream plates, on Grass and on the dark token. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-caller.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-caller.notes: The Caller's bust: the round brass diving helmet with its green porthole in place of a head, the cream conch held up beside it and the indigo robe's shoulders, as the map sprite; the hood tip of the sibling edit is gone. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-chosen.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:SWORDSMAN
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-chosen.notes: The Chosen's bust, a sibling of the Initiate's: broad shoulders, cream sashes crossed on the chest with a brass medal and one finger pointing up beside the hood. Differences from the sprite: the hood keeps a tall tip and the sash is crossed, not single. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-familiar.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:RAIDER
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-familiar.notes: The Familiar whole, as the map sprite: a pet sitting upright with pointed ears, bat wings, a cream belly and muzzle and a brass collar with a bell. Pixen drew its fur azure; the cult-lodge-icon accent makes it the sprite's indigo (and its pink ears and nose with it). Its eyes have pupils, as the sprite's do. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-herald.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:HERALD
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-herald.notes: The Herald close up: one huge pale yellow eye with a black pupil under the crown of teal tentacles, a brass collar and the indigo robe's shoulders, as the map sprite. The eye and the crown fill the frame. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-hexer.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:MARKSMAN
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-hexer.notes: The Hexer's bust, a sibling of the Initiate's: the curled hood tip, brass spectacles on the hood, two cream eyes and a green squiggle over the raised mitten, as the map sprite. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-horror.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:HORROR
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-horror.notes: The Horror whole, as the map sprite: a round teal ball on tentacle legs with two googly yellow eyes, a wide grin of blunt cream teeth, a brass spiked collar and a cream belly; the two horns of the creation are gone. No red or violet. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-idol-beare.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:GUARD
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-idol-beare.notes: The Idol Bearer's bust, a sibling of the Initiate's: the indigo hood with the pale stone idol head with green eyes sitting on top, two cream eyes and cream mittens. The idol is smaller than the head under it (the sprite's is as big). Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-initiate.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:FIGHTER
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-initiate.notes: The Initiate's bust, also the faction emblem of the setup form and the Gallery until the emblem is wired: the indigo hood with its floppy tip, the black opening with two plain cream eyes, the candle with its green flame in a cream mitten and a brass badge, as the map sprite. 516 cloth pixels, all on the lodge's indigo; no red or violet. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 on the cream plates beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-stargazer.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-stargazer.notes: The Stargazer's bust, a sibling of the Initiate's: the starry nightcap with its cream pompom and a brass telescope at the eye, as the map sprite. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-summoner.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:CAPTAIN
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-summoner.notes: The Summoner's bust, a sibling of the Initiate's: the tall straight pointed hood to the top of the square, a cream collar and a brass hand bell, as the map sprite. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-tentacle.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:TENTACLE
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-tentacle.notes: The Tentacle whole, as the map sprite: one S-shaped teal limb with cream suckers and one yellow eye at its tip, nothing at its foot. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6 beside the sprite.

chibi-direction-portrait-cult-thing.subject: PORTRAIT:CULT:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-direction-portrait-cult-thing.notes: The Thing in the Cellar whole: a heap of teal tentacles with many yellow eyes, the round wooden trapdoor lid in its middle and the striped party hat on top, as the map sprite; a taller heap than the sprite's. No red or violet. Reviewed at 1:1 and x6.
